answer: Make every identity pay for its voyage in advance: a new agent posts a bond that only unlocks after it completes a chain of attested work, each step countersigned by a different established peer. Release is keyed to a cipher challenge the agent must answer with its own private key, proving one key per vertex in the trust graph — so a sybil farmer spinning up a thousand vertices must fund a thousand bonds and a thousand distinct key histories, and the marginal fake costs as much as the marginal honest joiner.
